title: M1: Account service REST API (accounts, balances, transactions)
body:
Spring Boot 3 endpoints for accounts and transactions with Bean Validation and a global exception handler.

- [ ] GET /api/accounts, GET /api/accounts/{id}/transactions (paged)
- [ ] OpenAPI/Swagger docs
- [ ] Unit tests with JUnit 5 + Mockito

title: M1: PostgreSQL + Flyway schema
body:
- [ ] Docker Compose Postgres
- [ ] Flyway migrations for customer, account, transaction
- [ ] Spring Data JPA repositories + Testcontainers test

title: M1: JWT authentication with Spring Security
body:
- [ ] Sign up / login / refresh token
- [ ] BCrypt password hashing
- [ ] Lock account after 5 failed attempts
- [ ] RBAC: CUSTOMER and ADMIN roles

title: M2: Angular portal shell, login and route guards
body:
- [ ] Angular 17+ app in /portal
- [ ] HTTP interceptor for JWT

title: M2: Dashboard, transactions page and CSV export
body:

- [ ] Transactions: paging, filters, search

title: M2: Transfers with idempotency keys
body:
- [ ] Transfer between own accounts with confirm step
- [ ] Idempotency-Key header so double clicks never double-send
- [ ] Audit log entry for every transfer

title: M3: Kafka in Docker Compose + transaction simulator
body:
- [ ] Kafka + Schema Registry in Compose

title: M3: Fraud service (rule-based scoring)
body:
- [ ] Rules: amount spike, two countries within 1 hour
- [ ] Publish to fraud-alerts topic

title: M3: Ledger service with exactly-once updates
body:
- [ ] Outbox pattern or Kafka transactions

body:

body:
